title: Fixed Admin host-local inspection and targeted Production readiness probe

phases.objective: Expose a fixed Admin-only system dispatcher for exact-SHA Hostinger role-local full inspection and a bounded read-only Production activation readiness probe, without accepting credentials, migration, provider, workflow, SQL, shell, or mutation controls.

e2e_journeys.actor: Production Admin GPT through fixed system dispatcher
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The fixed dispatcher invokes the existing host-local adapter directly after admin authorization, exact identity binding, and request allowlist validation; it returns bounded read-only evidence with migration omitted and all mutation flags false.
steps: Submit only expected_sha and optional target_key=production-runtime through the Admin system-tool call.
Authorize the fixed tool for an admin/service principal before adapter invocation.
Bind the running Production repository, branch, and exact SHA before any database connection.
Read the three independent Hostinger role identities from the Hostinger process environment.
Run database.full_inspection in dry_run mode and return sanitized evidence without GitHub dispatch, migration, grant, SQL, shell, or workflow execution.
assertions: non-admin principals are rejected before adapter invocation
the request schema accepts only expected_sha and target_key
identity mismatch fails closed before database connection
host_local_role_env is unavailable to Staging and is never accepted as a caller-controlled field
database_mutation_performed, migration_apply_performed, grant_mutation_performed, and workflow_dispatch_performed are false
the fixed tool does not route through the generic endpoint facade

e2e_journeys.actor: Production Admin GPT through fixed system dispatcher
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The dispatcher returns the bounded readiness contract for MCP catalog schema, governance DB privilege, and runtime persistence without loading the oversized catalog and without performing writes.
steps: Submit an empty tool_args object as an admin/service principal.
Run the three existing readiness readers in read-only mode.
Return checks, bounded dimension status, mutation attestation, and sanitized error codes.
Reject non-empty arguments or non-admin principals before readiness readers execute.
assertions: the result contains no secrets and reports mutation flags explicitly
the probe does not enumerate or depend on the oversized dynamic catalog response
